#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

const double EPS = 1e-9;

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n;
    cin >> n;
    if (n > 11) {
        cout << 0 << endl;
        return 0;
    }

    vector<vector<int>> pts(n, vector<int>(5));
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < 5; j++) {
            cin >> pts[i][j];
        }
    }

    vector<int> ans;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        bool good = true;
        for (int j = 0; j < n && good; j++) {
            if (j == i) continue;
            for (int k = j + 1; k < n && good; k++) {
                if (k == i) continue;
                int dot = 0;
                double sq1 = 0, sq2 = 0;
                for (int d = 0; d < 5; d++) {
                    int v1 = pts[j][d] - pts[i][d];
                    int v2 = pts[k][d] - pts[i][d];
                    dot += v1 * v2;
                    sq1 += v1 * v1;
                    sq2 += v2 * v2;
                }
                double angle = acos(dot / (sqrt(sq1) * sqrt(sq2)));
                if (angle < M_PI / 2 - EPS) {
                    good = false;
                }
            }
        }
        if (good) {
            ans.push_back(i + 1);
        }
    }

    cout << ans.size() << endl;
    for (int idx : ans) {
        cout << idx << endl;
    }

    return 0;
}
